scope: Previously absent cast-exclusive and raid Ultimate Skills

records.name: Gigantic Ki Blast
records.character_source: Crystal Raid boss / Expert Mission super villains
records.unlock_method: Expert Mission 18: The Ultimate Evil: Broly!
records.effect: Massive Ki Blast; the Expert Mission boss version can be pushed back by repeated Ki attacks, while the Crystal Raid edition uses a cooldown.

records.name: Explosive Scream
records.effect: Cell Max charges a gigantic Ki Blast, compresses it, and launches it; players can interrupt the charge by attacking.

records.name: Final Galick Rush
records.effect: A rush of physical strikes followed by a Super Galick Gun, totaling 31 hits.

records.name: Super Dragon Flight (Ultimate)
records.effect: Two consecutive uppercuts, serving as the Ultimate variant of Super Dragon Flight.

notes: All four identities were absent from docs/data/skills.json at audit time. Dedicated Xenoverse 2 documentation establishes their canonical class/subcategory and, where available, Ki cost and CaC status. Gigantic Ki Blast is a special Crystal Raid/Expert Mission skill: the source describes it as usable by a CaC in its player version, while the boss edition uses raid-specific behavior. 2026-09-24 verification: current Xenoverse 2 Ultimate Attack documentation independently lists Final Galick Rush and Super Dragon Flight (Ultimate) at 300 Ki and in the cast-exclusive section; Explosive Scream remains an unobtainable Cell Max Ki Blast Ultimate. No unsupported acquisition or CaC status changes were made.
